name: helena-wordpress
description:
Helena by Enrich Labs helps you draft and manage content on your connected WordPress sites.

Review existing posts, pages, and supported custom content types. Research topics, prepare new content, improve existing copy, and publish or update content when you approve the action.

Use your saved business preferences, research, workspace files, and content calendar to organize your editorial work. Generate images, videos, and music; compose videos; inspect existing media; and transcribe audio.

Requires an Enrich Labs account and an authorized WordPress connection. Available actions depend on your site's capabilities and account permissions. Publishing, scheduling, and changes to your site's content require explicit approval.

Helena is independently developed and supported by Enrich Labs and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WordPress, the WordPress Foundation, or Automattic.

defaultPrompt: Show my connected WordPress blogs and publishing destinations.
List my recent WordPress blog posts.
Draft a short WordPress blog article about planning marketing content and save it to my workspace.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies product identity following affiliation/trademark review feedback. Renames the listing to Helena for WordPress, identifies Enrich Labs as the independent developer, and states that Helena is not affiliated with WordPress, the WordPress Foundation, or Automattic. Describes existing supported site-content workflows and user approval requirements. Endpoint, tools, icon, reviewer test scenarios, and demo recording are preserved; test prompts use the updated product name.

review.commerce_description: Does not process purchases or payments. Site publishing and content changes require user approval.

positive.prompt: Show my connected WordPress blogs and publishing destinations.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the connected CMS destinations and IDs.

positive.prompt: List my recent WordPress blog posts.
positive.expected_behavior: Read existing articles and their provider IDs.

positive.prompt: Draft a short WordPress blog article about planning marketing content and save it to my workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Save article text without publishing or creating a live CMS post.

positive.prompt: Show my connected integrations, Helena plan limits, and saved business preferences. Do not modify anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected account context; do not load new tools or execute other provider operations.

positive.prompt: Save a short summary of our WordPress findings to my workspace, then read it back.
positive.expected_behavior: Save and retrieve a text file in the account workspace only; do not mutate provider data or calendar records.

negative.prompt: Use only the Helena for WordPress connector. Refund Shopify order #1042.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not process refunds or send email; these operations are not exposed by this connector.

negative.prompt: Use only the Helena for WordPress connector. Send a Klaviyo email campaign now.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse provider execution outside the connector channel. Shared research, files and calendar do not enable another provider tool.

negative.prompt: Use only the Helena for WordPress connector. Run a shell command to call an arbitrary API.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse arbitrary shell/API execution; use only the explicitly declared fixed tools.
